description: Source code implementing a memory-efficient string-to-string map data structure (zipmap) used in Redis for small hashes, including functions for creation, lookup, insertion, deletion, iteration, and integrity validation.

methods.name: zipmapDecodeLength
methods.description: Decodes the length value from a pointer in the zipmap encoding.

methods.name: zipmapGetEncodedLengthSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the encoded length at a pointer.

methods.name: zipmapEncodeLength
methods.description: Encodes a length value into a buffer, or returns the size needed if buffer is NULL.

methods.name: zipmapLookupRaw
methods.description: Finds a key in the zipmap and returns a pointer to its entry.

methods.name: zipmapRequiredLength
methods.description: Calculates the required length in bytes for a key-value pair.

methods.name: zipmapRawKeyLength
methods.description: Returns total bytes used by a key entry.

methods.name: zipmapRawValueLength
methods.description: Returns total bytes used by a value entry.

methods.name: zipmapRawEntryLength
methods.description: Returns total bytes used by a key-value entry.

methods.name: zipmapResize
methods.description: Resizes the zipmap buffer to a specified length.

methods.name: zipmapSet
methods.description: Sets a key to a value in the zipmap, creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: zipmapDel
methods.description: Deletes a key from the zipmap.

methods.name: zipmapRewind
methods.description: Prepares for iteration over zipmap entries.

methods.name: zipmapNext
methods.description: Iterates to the next key-value pair in the zipmap.

methods.name: zipmapGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key.

methods.name: zipmapExists
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the zipmap.

methods.name: zipmapLen
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the zipmap.

methods.name: zipmapBlobLen
methods.description: Returns the raw size in bytes of the zipmap.

methods.name: zipmapValidateIntegrity
methods.description: Validates the integrity of the zipmap data structure.
